title: SPOT: An Annotated French Corpus and Benchmark for Detecting Critical Interventions in Online Conversations
reasoning: The paper focuses on operationalizing the sociological concept of 'stopping points' as a binary classification task for detecting critical interventions in online threads. While the conceptual framework mentions that users may employ 'moral' critiques, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics; it aims to classify conversational pragmatics.
